# ConfUSIus

> Python package for analysis and visualization of functional ultrasound imaging data.

This file describes ConfUSIus version 0.9.0.dev0. ConfUSIus is a Python library built on xarray for loading, registering, extracting signals from, and visualizing functional ultrasound imaging (fUSI) data. Every spatial array is a VoxelData `xarray.DataArray` with dims `(..., time, pose, k, j, i)` and a voxel-to-world affine index. Install with `pip install confusius`. The package is in beta and the API may change between releases.
